anchors.static_observation: Liquidation valuation adds signed position PnL and price impact to collateral USD and subtracts token-denominated costs converted at collateral price.min. This is a health valuation, not an available token balance.
Nonpositive remaining equity is a liquidation condition, alongside minimum collateral and leverage thresholds.
Collateral-sufficiency calculation deducts negative realized PnL but does not credit positive PnL; keep this check distinct from liquidation equity.
validatePosition can reject a liquidatable position. This guard is not the same as executing a permitted liquidation order.
Insolvent early close requires a full size reduction and either liquidation order or secondary ADL classification. Later caller checks and transaction success are separate.
handleEarlyReturn rejects unpaid costs when the insolvent-close condition is false. This is a concrete source refusal candidate.
Allowed insolvent early return emits the remainingCostUsd and payment step, then returns empty fee values; this event is not a self-executing insurance payout or a proven debt ledger.
Insufficient collateral-token funding payment emits expected/paid primary and paid secondary amounts. Comments proposing pool top-up/insurance are not an executed automatic top-up.
Funding paid in secondary output tokens requires a nonzero configured holding address before recording claimable collateral for that address.
payForCost first rounds cost upward in collateral-token units, then consumes output collateral tokens and remaining position collateral.
Secondary token conversion uses integer division. Explicit accounting must distinguish source-rounded remainingCostUsd from an exact rational residual and preserve dust/valuation assumptions.
Requested collateral withdrawal is capped by remainingCollateralAmount at this stage; unrealized equity must not be silently substituted for these token units.
Funding has separate unsigned fee and long/short claimable token amounts; fee calculation rounds up, claimable calculations round down. Signed net reconciliation must retain asset/unit identity.
Funding is derived from a checked unsigned cumulative-factor difference and size via scaled mulDiv; this is not an unconstrained signed cash increment.
Claimable funding is keyed by market/token/account; accrual and claim logic operate on these records separately from position collateral.
claimFundingFees clears claimable records and transfers the selected token before balance validation. Other functions share transferOut calls; the claim path is bounded by its function body.
